In this paper the traffic sign samples extracted from the GTSRB database, including 780 training samples and 120 testing samples, the result shows that the recognition rate of test sample is up to 100% with 2.97 ms/frame.

articleTitle: Discriminative Topic Sparse Representation for Text Categorization
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In text categorization, feature representation for dimensionality reduction is a key step. Usually, some commonly used methods, e.g., latent semantic analysis (LSA), yield a dense representation or a dense transformation matrix, which is difficult to precisely characterize the document-topic or the topic-word relationship. This paper proposes a novel discriminative topic sparse representation (DTSR) approach for text categorization, in which two stages are included: the topic dictionary construction and sparse representation. Firstly, a discriminative and interpretable dictionary is constructed to characterize the topic-word relationship. The dictionary contains all category center vectors as well as some semantic topic vectors generated by a latent Dirichlet allocation (LDA) model. Furthermore, each document can be represented with a sparse form to obtain a good document-topic relationship. Experimental results on well-known benchmark datasets indicate that the proposed method not only achieves a satisfactory classification performance but also provides a reasonable sparse semantic meaningful.

articleTitle: Acquisition of Open Source Software Project Maturity Based on Time Series Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this study, with time series machine learning, the traits data of GitHub open source project was used to establish a model named open source maturity model. This model used timeseries machine learning(OMMTML), which was compared with the traditional open source software maturity assessment model and open source project analyze framework (OSPAF). The aim is to reveal how the model is different in finding the mature project. We use the project recommended by the open source community as a standard for mature projects, and the result shows that the model has better versatility and accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-warehouse Location of Logistics Based on Dijkstra and Divide-and-Conquer Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Warehouse location is extremely important in the whole logistics system. Existing methods to solve this problem, such as Genetic Algorithm or Simulated Annealing Algorithm, require long-term adjustment to get optimal parameters which need redesign when data set change, therefore these methods are not well universal applicability. This paper proposes a heuristic algorithm based on Dijkstra and Divide-and-Conquer Algorithm. Firstly, the sub-problem blocks are constructed. Then, each block is used to calculate the appropriate warehouses. Finally, re-calculate the whole graph to get the final solution based on previous warehouse locations. Simulation results show that the algorithm in this paper can greatly reduce the computation time while get right solution, moreover, there are good solutions for different graphs, and general applicability is strong.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-disciplinary Design Optimization for Marine Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on the current problem that overall design of the marine power plant lacks effective method and inter-disciplinary coupling analysis to meet technical and tactical requirements, Multidisciplinary Design Optimization was proposed to apply to the overall design process of marine power plant. Firstly, combined with the development of MDO, decomposition of disciplines, academic coupling, decoupling and other key technologies about marine power plant are studied to put forward MDO method of overall design for ship power plant. Furthermore, based on the calculation of shaft alignment and lateral vibration, an example of the Multidisciplinary Design Optimization of the shaft was given. Meanwhile, MDO strategy, optimization algorithm, approximation method, sensitivity analysis, calculation support platform design were studied. Through the research in the paper, a new scientific method, which meets the technical and tactical requirement of overall design process about marine power plant was put forward. This method would be used as a reference to improving the overall design of marine power plant.

articleTitle: A Path Planning Algorithm Based on Fluid Simulation
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The paper discussed a path planning algorithm based on fluid simulation, and transform the ship's optimal trajectory problem into solving the flow field around a plate in a tube with obstacles. Due to the fact that the optimal route is similar to the streamline in water with obstacles in general. Firstly, the lattice Boltzmann method simulates the flow field. Then the optimal curves can be calculated by screening tracks of the particles following the orientation field. The result of experimental simulation of the algorithm show that the proposed method could find a desirable route.

articleTitle: The Pruning Algorithm of Parallel Shared Decision Tree Based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Shared knowledge mining refers to learn the sharing knowledge of different things, and applying the learned knowledge to the unknowns to accelerate the recognition of them. For the problems of low efficiency and the traditional memory classification algorithm unable to deal with massive data, then combined with the cloud computing technology, A Parallel Shared Decision Tree (PSDT) algorithm had been proposed. Although this algorithm improved the efficiency, the performance still needs to be optimized for leaving the influence of the training set noise out of consideration. So, in this paper, based on the PSDT algorithm, a parallel shared decision tree imprecise error pruning (PSDT-IEP) algorithm is proposed. In our algorithm, we reduced the impact of unreliability by using the classification number of the uncertainty probability error of the data set to prune, which improves the accuracy of the algorithm. Along with the increase of the data set, the superiority of PSDT-IEP is more obvious.

articleTitle: Design on Optimization of Phase for Urban Traffic Coordinated Control
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The optimization of signal cycle and green ratio for intersection of coordinated control can improve the traffic performance, but it is difficult to obtain the best two-way bandwidth in the smaller space of solution which can be approximated optimization, in order to reduce more the vehicle delay at intersection, the space of optimal solution is expanded by adjusting phase, based on multi-population genetic algorithm, the scheme of phase optimized design was proposed. According to the principle of vehicles reach steadily, the vehicle delay model was established. The minimum of vehicle average delay was regarded as the evaluation index for coordinated control of benefit and the multi-population genetic algorithm was used to implement the automatic optimization of the phase, which is simulated and verified by VISSIM. The result shows that the method of phase optimized design can reduce the average vehicles delay by 5% and reduce the average number of parking by 28.9%, which can effectively improve the rapidity and effectiveness of the method of combination and traversal.

articleTitle: Learning Deep Features for Classification of Typical Ecological Environmental Elements in High-Resolution Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Ecological environmental elements are greatly related to both humans and nature. The rapid development of remote sensing technology has provided us more and more high-resolution remote sensing images for monitoring these elements timely and objectively. However, it has been a great challenge to recognize these elements from such images due to their diversity and complexity. In this paper, a classification approach of ecological environmental elements based on deep learning features of objects is proposed. At first, a deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) is trained for discriminating different ecological environmental elements. To extract deep features of irregular-shaped regions, sub-images are clipped from each region and used to represent the corresponding region. Then, deep features of these sub-images are extracted by the trained DCNN. After that, the softmax classifier is used to predict class probabilities of all sub-images. The class of one region is determined by considering the class probabilities of its sub-images according to the "winner-takes-all" strategy. Finally, the thematic maps of ecological environmental elements are achieved. The proposed approach is evaluated by the classification experiments on a test set of typical ecological environmental elements in high-resolution remote sensing images, and the classification accuracy reaches to 98.44%. Moreover, the classification accuracy on irregular-shaped regions also reaches to 96.77%. These results have testified the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Clustream Algorithm Based on Spark
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of information society, producing a steady stream of data in daily life. These large amounts of data need to be analyzed in real time in order to obtain the value. Based on the original Clustream algorithm, this paper proposes a CClustream clustering algorithm based on Spark Streaming, which is based on the parallel implementation, and its offline part has been improved. Experiments show that the algorithm has better efficiency and accuracy than the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Distributed Control for Multirobot Systems with Collision-Free Motion Coordination
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper presents a distributed framework that ensures reliably collision-free behaviors in large-scale multirobot systems with switching interaction topologies. We show how a multirobot system achieves a natural collisionless aggregation through leader switching in the presence of obstacles. Although this method is mainly designed for collision avoidance, the velocity matching of robots is still achieved after the obstacle avoidance. The Separation (avoid robot-torobot collisions) rule is actively controlled through an artificial potential function of inter-robot distance. Based on the fluid theory, the Avoidance (avoid obstacles) rule is achieved by making robots track a set of generated virtual agents along the streamlines. In addition, a new species of "filtering agents" are designed to decrease the adverse effect. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: A Disease Detection Method of Liver Based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The computer-aid diagnosis of liver disease plays an important role in timely detection and treatment of liver. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) get problems of low accuracy. This paper introduces a method based on improved CNN and Random Forest(RF), which has a higher accuracy than traditional CNN.

articleTitle: Application of QFD and FMEA in Ship Power Plant Design
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In view of the lack of modern engineering design theory in the early stage of ship power plant as a support, focus on the experience and intuition of designers, and put forward the application of Quality Function Development (QFD) and Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (FMEA) Design of ship power plant. In this paper, the House of System analysis method is introduced to the overall design of QFD and FMEA integrated theory, and the key parts and weaknesses of the system are determined by the integration theory and the prevention and improvement measures are put forward. This study provides a new theoretical basis for the design of the ship's power plant, and provides an effective basis for improving the system reliability and improving the design quality.

articleTitle: Stereo Odometry Based on Careful Frame Selection
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel stereo visual odometry that provides states-of-the-art results. Our method firstly selects stable features by quad-matching testing and grid-based motion statistics. Instead performing odometry by using past consecutive frames as traditional methods, we select a reference frame by tracing the past frames back as far as possible which shares the stable features with the current frame, and odometry is performed using these two frames. In this way, we skip the frames laying between the two frames, and avoid the accumulation of errors across these frames. Experiments results show that our method outperforms other traditional visual odometry methods on KITTI dataset.

articleTitle: Research on the Production and Marketing Match Model of Agricultural Products Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In addition to the quality of the product itself factors, upstream and downstream consumption capacity requirements of effective connection can also make value-added agricultural products, it is also an important factor to decide whether agricultural products to achieve a premium. Firstly, this paper briefly expounds the matching mode of agricultural production and marketing of agricultural products at home and abroad. Secondly, the author analyzes information matching algorithms, further introduces the theory of analytic hierarchy process (AHP), and on this basis to build the production and marketing match model of agricultural products based on analytic hierarchy process.Through the analysis of the examples, it is concluded that the model constructed in this paper is of great practical significance for the rapid and accurate matching of the information in the production and marketing of agricultural products.

articleTitle: Design of Electrical Parameter Measurement System of Quartz Crystal Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Through the model analysis and electric parameter analysis of the quartz crystal oscillator and the test method of the electric parameters of the quartz crystal oscillator, the measurement system is designed. The measurement system which is based on zero phase technique in a π-network, uses the IEC444 Crystal oscillator test standard as the parameter calculation method. And a method of compensation correction is designed. The measurement range of crystal is 1-50MHz, the maximum number of measurable parameters are 10, including series and parallel resonant frequency, resonant resistance and so on. By comparing with the KH1240 tester's test results and the Error analysis of the test results, the accuracy of the testing resonance frequency is down to ±2ppm, it is proved that the system has good stability and practicability.

Author Keywords: zero phase technique in a p-network

articleTitle: Predicting Countermovement Jump Heights by Time Domain, Frequency Domain, and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce an experiment evaluating performance of football players in countermovement jumps (CMJs). Three methods including time domain, frequency domain, and machine learning algorithms are proposed for performance evaluation. Correlation coefficients and p-values are given for time domain and frequency domain methods, and prediction errors are given for different machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Iterative Unbiased Converted Measurement Kalman Filter for Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: It is important to develop a robust and fast tracking algorithm for modern tracking system because the target moves more and more fast. Therefore, a novel algorithm named the iterative unbiased converted measurement Kalman filter (IUCMKF) is proposed based on the analysis and comparison of conventional target tracking methods. The new algorithm is developed from unbiased converted measurement Kalman filter, but it can obtain more accurate state and covariance estimation. Compared with the existing target tracking approaches, the proposed method has potential advantages in tracking accuracy. The correctness as well as validity of the algorithm is demonstrated through numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: Preliminary Application of Gesture Recognition to Virtual Acupuncture
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine(TCM) is a style of traditional medicine built on a foundation of more than 2,500 years of Chinese medical practice, which includes various forms of herbal medicine, acupuncture, massag, qigong exercise, and dietary therapy. TCM is widely used in China and is becoming increasingly available in Europe and North America. Besides, acupuncture is a form of alternative medicine in which thin needles are inserted into the body. It is a key component of TCM. In our study, we focused on the virtual acupuncture training system, which is based on the Oculus virtual headset and gesture device - Leap Motion. However, the accuracy of gesture recognition is limited by the data collection from Leap Motion. In our study, our implementation is based on the data reduction, offline model training with Machine Learning algorithms, and online gesture recognition for acupuncture. The experiments showed that our system can really improve the recognition results on the three gesture types, when we tried to use the virtual acupuncture system.

articleTitle: A Reversible Data Hiding Scheme for HEVC
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Many reversible data hiding schemes using quantized DCT coefficient have been proposed recently. But the big problem was most of schemes could not meet the requirement of visual quality and robustness at the same time. This paper presents a reversible data hiding scheme for HEVC (High Efficiency Video Coding). The scheme toke visual quality and robustness into account after embedding. And then the mid-frequency location in the appropriate set of the 8x8 block was selected. The coefficient near to the mid-frequency would be selected to embed the secret data. The results show that this scheme has better visual quality and good robustness, and has low influence on bitrates at the same time.

articleTitle: Harbor Detection in Large-Scale Remote Sensing Images Using Both Deep-Learned and Topological Structure Features
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Detecting harbors in large-scale remote sensing images has been a great challenge due to their relatively small areas and complex backgrounds. Furthermore, harbors usually contain different artificial or natural structures, which also increase the difficulty to detect them. A three-step harbor detection framework using both deep-learned and topological structure features is proposed in this paper. Firstly, coastal zones are found by Deep Residual Network (ResNet). Then, based on those coastal zones, different sizes of wharves are identified by Single Shot Multi-box Detector (SSD). Finally, semi-closed structure detector and bounding-box merging are implemented to obtain the final detection results. The experiments on large-scale remote sensing images have shown the proposed framework have better performances than those of both ResNet and SSD alone. The recall rate of the proposed framework is higher than that of ResNet about 15.9%, and that of SSD about 13.1%.

articleTitle: Hybrid Metaheuristic for Multi-objective Steelmaking-Continuous Casting Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the special process requirements of steelmaking-continuous casting (SCC) scheduling, a constraint satisfaction model is established with the objectives of the total waiting time, idle time of the machines, and the earliness and tardiness time of the casts. Furthermore, an NSGA-MOPSO algorithm with the adaptive grid selection strategy (AGSS) is proposed, which effectively overcome the problem of easily losing the useful information that use traditional Pareto domination method. Finally, experiments and compared algorithm are set up and the results show that the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed NSGA-MOPSO algorithm.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Face Detector Based on an End-to-End CNN
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks with deeply trained make a significant performance improvement in face detection. However, the major shortcomings, i.e. need of high computational cost and slow calculation, make the existing CNN-based face detectors impractical in many applications. In this paper, a real-time approach for face detection was proposed by utilizing a single end-to-end deep neural network with multi-scale feature maps, multi-scale prior aspect ratios as well as confidence rectification. Multi-scale feature maps overcome the difficulties of detecting small face, and meanwhile, multiscale prior aspect ratios reduce the computing cost and the confidence rectification, which is in line with the biological intuition and can further improve the detection rate. Evaluated on the public benchmark, FDDB, the proposed algorithm, gained a performance as good as the state-of-the-art CNN-based methods, however, with much faster speed.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Suspicious Stay Detection System Based on Face Detection and Tracking in Monitor Videos
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper proposed a novel approach of a suspicious stay detection system based on face detection and tracking. Through the intelligent analysis of real-time monitor videos, we judge whether there is any suspicious stay in the monitoring area. In the proposed system, we firstly set the face detection and tracking area. Then we use the convolution neural network algorithm to detect the face and the Particle Filter to track the face. Finally, the time someone stays in the surveillance area is used to determine whether he is stuck suspiciously. Experimental results show that the proposed approach has a relatively high accuracy, and meets the real-time requirement.

articleTitle: Estimation of Distribution Algorithm with Machine Learning for Permutation Flowshop Scheduling with Total Tardiness Criterion
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper studies a permutation flowshop scheduling problem (PFSP) with the objective of total tardiness minimization. An improved estimation of distribution algorithm with machine learning, named ML-EDA, is proposed. This algorithm divides the job permutation into several segments and introduces an external archive to keep elite solutions. A two-layer probability model is then constructed in the ML-EDA, and the statistical learning method is employed to produce the probability that the each of job falls at each segment and the probability that the job falls at each location in the segment. Computational results based on benchmark illustrated that the ML-EDA can obtain better solution than the standard EDA for the permutation flowshop scheduling problem with the objective of minimizing total tardiness.

articleTitle: Design of a sEMG Signal Acquisition Instrument for Physical Rehabilitation Training
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The sEMG signal can directly reflect a variety of information about the activity of specific muscle and nerve. By extracting and studying the characteristics of sEMG signal, the body movements, diagnosis of muscle disease and medical rehabilitation can be effectively identified. Based on these features, a sEMG signal acquisition instrument was designed for body rehabilitation training. The low-pass filter circuit and signal acquisition circuit were designed by ADS1294 physiological signal processing chip, and the acquisition of sEMG signal from 1Hz ~ 500Hz was completed. In order to read and send signals, the software based STM32 master control circuit was designed. The test results show that the SEMG signal acquisition device can collect real-time data of 4-channel EMG signal, and accurately reflect the release of sEMG signal. Therefore, it has great real-time and reliability.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Set Pair Analysis in Risk Assessment of Shallow Groundwater Pollution
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: There are not more studies on whether the improved set pair analysis(SPA) could apply to risk assessment of shallow groundwater pollution. In order to make the most of this method, this paper firstly puts forward the pollution risk analysis model according to the pollution process and constructs a risk assessment system of shallow groundwater pollution even associates it with unascertained measure theory and analytic hierarchy process. The analytic hierarchy process is used to determine the weight of each layer; The measure function decides the membership degree of the index layer for calculating the unascertained evaluation matrix of the system layer; The connection number of set pair analysis is linked to the level of pollution risk assessment. The evaluation example is used to identify the feasibility about the method of the improved set pair analysis, and the result is entirely feasible. Moreover, this improved approach shows the actual pollution risk situation.

articleTitle: Low Light Image Enhancement Based on Luminance Map and Haze Removal Model
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, a novel and effective algorithm is proposed for noise reduction and contrast enhancement in low light images based on luminance map and haze removal model. The proposed method is divided into two steps: i) A combined denoising method using the improved guided filtering based on gradient information and median filtering is proposed to obtain the initial denoised image. ii) Considering that an inverted low light image presents quite similar to a haze image, the haze removal model is used to enhance the denoised low light image.The luminance component L is extracted to obtain the transmission map with the adaptive weight from the inverted denoised image which is applied to Lab color space. Then the classical quad-tree subdivision is utilized to estimate the atmospheric light, and then the de-hazed image is recovered by the haze removal model. At last, we can get the final enhanced image by inverting the de-hazed image back. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm reduces the noise and enhances the contrast of the low light image more effectively and robustly than the conventional and the state-of-the-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Recommender Algorithm Based on Comments and Score
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Accompanied by rapid development of Internet technology, people are increasingly dependent on the network. In the past, people is usually passive to accept information, but today people begin to take the initiative to create information. This case makes network data more and more. In order to ease information overload caused by inconvenience, recommender system has gradually been people's attention. Through the appropriate recommended technology, it can help people to filter out useless content, reduce the amount of information faced by individuals. In the recommender system, collaborative filtering recommendation is a more widely used method. In order to improve the recommended results, this paper based on the traditional method of rating. Using user's comments, emotional analysis tools to extract the emotional polarity of comments, combine emotional polarity and rating to enhance final recommended effect.

articleTitle: Load Scheduling of Thermostatical House-Hold Appliances Against Abrupt Changes in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The security of power grid is of great importance for the development of modern society, and the balance of supply and demand is critical to ensure the reliability and security. Smart appliances, which are important parts of smart grid and can help balance the supply and demand. The load scheduling can decide whether the appliances should be running or resting at some point, and the load scheduling of thermostatical house-hold appliances can help securing the smart grid when abrupt changes occur. However, the load scheduling should be user-friendly, which have been ignored in many researches. In this paper, user-friendliness indicators of a load scheduling are given. We propose a load scheduling of thermostatical house-hold appliances against abrupt changes in smart grid, and each appliance is treated as an agent. Each agent chooses to run or rest based on the state of the smart grid and its own state. The simulation results show that the load scheduling we propose is user-friendly and can keep the smart grid in a safe state.

articleTitle: Study on Surface Characteristics of Shearing Marks Based on Correlation Dimension
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this experimental study, the 5mm round lead is used as a bearing mark object, three kinds of clamp shear tool, such as scissors, wire clamp and broken clamp, are used as create traces of objects to get shear trace sample. The surface profile curves of the shear traces were collected and a set of data sequences were obtained. The data sequences were reconstructed by state space rebuild. Firstly, the delay factor of the data sequence is determined by using the inter-function method. Then, the embedding dimension of the data sequence is determined by the pseudo-neighbor method. Finally, the correlation dimension of the contour curve of the shear traces is calculated by G-P algorithm. The results show that the correlation dimension of the three different shear traces is obviously different. It is proved that the G-P algorithm is effective for a set of data sequences, and the correlation dimension is sensitive to the no uniformity of a group of data series. Therefore, the correlation dimension can better reflect the fractal nature of the object, and can be used as a quantitative index to describe the specificity of the traces surface. This research provides a new calculation method for the identification of the line traces.

articleTitle: Research on Influence Evaluation Algorithm of Tibetan Micro-Blog User Behavior
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The user influence evaluation is the basis and hotspot in micro-blog research currently. Micro-blog user influence evaluation algorithm based on user behavior weight is proposed in this paper order to improve the accuracy of Tibetan micro-blog user communication impact evaluation. The comment, forwarding, like, @, storage of Tibetan micro-blog user are analyed according to the characteristics of Tibetan micro-blog. BP neural network is adopted for learning in order to find the most reasonable weight and establish communication influence measurement model. The specific data are adopted for the simulation test of algorithm performance. The results show that compared with Tibetan micro-blog user impact strength algorithm, this algorithm not only improves the evaluation accuracy of Tibetan micro-blog user influence, but also can describe various user behavior's contribution to network transmissibility, which has provided a more reliable reference for the detection and guidance of Tibetan online public sentiment.

articleTitle: Multi-query Optimization via Common Sub Query Elimination for SPARQL
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As the main query language on RDF data, SPARQL constantly drawing attention from the Semantic Web communities. In this paper we present a mechanism that can identify common sub queries in multiple RDF queries and eliminate redundant sub queries, significantly improving the efficiency of executing multiple RDF queries, both simultaneously and sequentially. Unlike previous optimization works concentrated on optimizing a single RDF query, our method focus on improving the performance of multiple similar RDF queries, which commonly occur in real world applications related to RDF data. Extensive experiments over benchmark RDF repositories of millions of triples confirm that our method is superior to the state-of-the-art methods when common sub queries exist in multiple SPARQL queries.

articleTitle: Feature Combination Tracking
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Multiple kernel learning methods have been successfully applied to visual tracking by finding the best combination of the kernels using boosting techniques. However, they are still not effective in tracking objects with large appearance variations and are not able to generate qualified combinations. In this paper, we propose a tracking framework by leveraging the multiple features via feature combination. By using multiple features combined with the LPBoost technique, our method is able to compute better combinations than others. This framework exploits both local and global features of image patches, thereby generating more accurate tracking results. In addition, a template update strategy is introduced to let the proposed framework more robust to partial occlusion. Experiments on challenging video sequences demonstrate that the proposed tracking algorithm outperforms several state-of-the-art methods in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations.

articleTitle: Automatic Posture Alignment Method of Spacecraft in Docking Process of Solar Wing
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Solar wing provides energy for the whole spacecraft and the docking quality of solar wing directly influences whether solar wing can be smoothly started and put into normal operation after launching of spacecraft. First of all, traditional posture alignment method of spacecraft in docking process of solar wing is analyzed so as to point out existing disadvantages; secondly, detailed description is provided for system composition, principles for posture alignment and technological process of automatic posture alignment method of spacecraft so as to clarify coordinate transformation relationship in process of posture alignment; thirdly, error in posture alignment method is analyzed to formulate corresponding control methods; in the end, verification is carried out for automatic posture alignment method for docking engineering test of solar wing and the results show that: the method for automatic posture alignment of spacecraft is feasible and the posture of spacecraft can meet docking requirements of solar wing after 1 to 2 times of adjustment. The method can provide reference for docking process of similar large components.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Visualization Technology of Electromagnetic Field Based on OSG
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Visualization technology has been widely used in many fields, but research in the field of electromagnetic is still in the exploratory stage. Based on the introduction of electromagnetic field visualization process, this paper studies the visualization method of electromagnetic scalar data and vector data, especially focuses on the analysis and optimization of the ray projection algorithm, which reduces the computational cost, improves the drawing speed and greatly improves the drawing of the electromagnetic vector data. Finally, the visualization of electromagnetic scalar and vector data is realized by using classic MC algorithm and optimized ray projection algorithm on open source 3D rendering engine OSG. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the rendering of 3D electromagnetic field.

articleTitle: Constant Bearing Guidance Law for Homing Missiles
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A constant bearing guidance algorithms in the two-dimensional intercept problem is presented for homing missile. It avoids the difficulties of accurately measuring the target velocity vector and azimuth etc. by using this method. It only needs relative distance between the target and missile, the angle of line of sight and their rate of change. At the same time, an advanced TD filter based on Lyapunov stability theory is given which can output high precision information for the new guidance law. Simulation results show that the missile hit the target accurately while the target performs a sinusoidal maneuver, and the missile trajectory is close to a straight line. It verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Identification Method of Vehicle Driving Cycle Based on LVQ Model
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to solve the real-time identification problem of vehicle driving cycle, an intelligent identification method of vehicle driving cycle based on learning vector quantization (LVQ) model is designed. Several typical driving cycles are selected as initial identification samples, which are partitioned to expand the identification sample space. Characteristic parameters, which can fully characterize the characteristics of driving conditions, are selected and normalized to obtain the standard characteristic parameter vectors. The driving cycle identification (DCI) model based on LVQ neural network are built with the training algorithm given to train the DCI model and the identificaton algorithm given to actualize DCI. The experimental results show that: the DCI model based on LVQ neural network presented in this paper can effectively recognize the actual driving conditions of the vehicle in real time, the identification accuracy is 88%.

articleTitle: Research on Method of Emergency Cases Retrieval Based on Case-Based Reasoning
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of emergency cases retrieval, this paper proposes a method of emergency cases retrieval considering the predator behavior of birds. Based on case-based reasoning (CBR) theory, this method introduces the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and tabu search (TS) into the calculation of attribute feature weight, and then calculates the similarity between target case and historical case for finding the most similar historical case. The validity and feasibility of the proposed method are verified by the collected data.

articleTitle: Application of Hadoop Based Distributed Data Cleaning Technology in Periodical Meta Data Integration
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As an important part of data mining, data cleaning is also facing great pressure on the cleaning of mass data.This paper firstly introduces the research status of this topic, and on the Hadoop platform and data cleaning, outlier mining algorithms were introduced, and then based on the data cleaning program typically described, by contrast, proposes a Hadoop distributed data cleaning method.Next, the inconsistency and repeatability of metadata in heterogeneous data source of digital library are analyzed, and solutions are proposed. The basic framework, process, cleaning strategy and algorithm of data cleaning in the process of periodical metadata integration are designed. Finally, the cleaning experiment is carried out to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the cleaning strategy and algorithm.

articleTitle: Human Motion Retrieval Based on Feedback Learning
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A novel content-based feedback learning motion retrieval approach is presented. The approach includes two primary stages. (1) In the learning stage, fuzzy clustering is first utilized to get the representative frames of motions, and the body gesture features are extracted to build a motion feature database. (2) In the motion retrieval stage, the query motion feature is extracted according to stage (1). Similarity measurements are then conducted by employing a novel method that combines Manhattan distance dynamic programming (MDP) and support vector machine (SVM) feedback learning. The retrieval results are ranked according to the feedback learning values. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified experimentally.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Ventilation Parameters in Roadway Type Stope Based on Fluent Software
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The blasting method is generally used in non-coal mine underground mining activity. However, blasting operations will result in massive release of several toxic and harmful gases, and these gases are of high concentration and difficult to exhaust as they can be rapidly spread and fully distributed in confined spaces, like stope and roadway, within a short time. In this paper, the Fluent software is used to analyze the distribution and diffusion regularities of those blast-induced gases. In order to facilitate the study, only CO is considered. The results indicate that with the increase of wind velocity in air inlet from 0.25 m/s to 4 m/s, the rate of CO concentration drop in the roadway type stope presents a linear tendency. The CO concentration after ventilating with wind velocity of 0.5 m/s is basically in line with the Chinese national safety standard, while CO concentrations in return air corner of the stope are still beyond the safety standard's limit. The CO concentration can meet the standard's requirement when the wind velocity is within the range of 1 m/s to 4 m/s, and the drop rates of CO concentration at 3 m/s and 4 m/s have little difference. On the basis of comprehensive analysis, the wind velocity in air inlet should be greater than 0.5 m/s, and less than 1 m/s.

articleTitle: Task Scheduling Simulation of Spacecraft Test Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The traditional test method of spacecraft can't content the increasing need of the future, for its mass quantity and large-scale. It is a complex issue to fulfill the task in short time and high resource usage. This thesis introduces a task schedule method based on genetic algorithm to solve the problem, mapping the spacecraft test into a production activity through modeling. The simulated test indicates that this method has some practical value with the ability of acquiring the optimal schedule scheme at express speed.

articleTitle: BSAIC: Identification of Significant Copy Number Aberrations in Cancer
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Because it helps to determine the location of driver genes and cancer suppressor genes, the identification of the significant aberration regions from the somatic copy numbers in cancer is vital to make clear the mechanisms of tumor initiation and progression. To address the problem of identifying Significant Copy Number Aberrations in cancer, in this paper, we have completed the following four tasks. (1) We have re-implemented GISTIC, JISTIC and SAIC in a Java project and published it as an open source project. (2) We have proposed an improved algorithm BSAIC based on both the significant detection algorithm SAIC and the famous parallel integrated learning method Bagging. (3) We have developed a mechanism for generating synthetic datasets aimed at such algorithms. (4) We have compared the performances of GISTIC, JISTIC, SAIC and BSAIC using the synthetic datasets, and proved the advantages of the BSAIC.

articleTitle: Navigation System of the Stacking Vehicle Based on Fuzzy Control and Laser Scanner
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper presents a navigation system customized for the automatic path tracking movement of the tracked stacking vehicle working in a shipping container. The vehicle is equipped with a 2D laser scanner for localization and navigation. Returned data is continuously sent back to the navigation system to be processed in order to identify the location of the vehicle relative to the container. For localization, a feature extraction algorithm based on the IEPF algorithm and the priori geometric features of the container is proposed. For navigation, a fuzzy logic controller is designed by implementing the path tracking error as input and track speed difference ratio as output. A fuzzy-logic set of rules is proposed based on human driving experience for path following control. The efficiency of the proposed navigation system is demonstrated through experiment.

articleTitle: Genetic Programming Based ECOC for Multiclass Microarray Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A genetic programming (GP) based algorithm is proposed to improve the performance of ECOC algorithms for multiclass microarray datasets. The individual of our GP is revised to solve a set of binary class problems decomposed by an ECOC algorithm directly, which picking up genes with biological significance simultaneously. Experimental results prove the effectiveness of our algorithm in five data sets.

articleTitle: Variational Optical Flow Based Velocity Estimation for Omni-Directional Intelligent Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To measure the velocity for the omni-directional intelligent wheelchair for the depth research on control and improve the measured accuracy and computational efficiency, the variational optical flow based velocity estimation method is used in this paper. Firstly, an improved energy functional model which combines a brightness constancy assumption, a gradient constancy assumption, a Laplacian constancy assumption and a discontinuity-preserving spatio-temporal smoothness constraint is employed to improve the accuracy of optical flow estimation; Then, a planar optical flow model based improved voting Random Sample Consensus(RANSAC) method is presented to remove heterogeneous optical flow vectors produced by non-uniform ambient illumination, local motion blur and chaotic surrounding environment. Finally, aiming at the installation attitude of the camera, an effective method of camera attitude adjustment is introduced to simplify the spatial coordinate system transformation and solve the model. This paper has realized the velocity estimation of the wheelchair by real-time acquisition of images in the framework of the Robot Operating System(ROS). Experimental results showed that the wheelchair velocity estimation method performed robustly in the presence of chaotic surrounding environment through the above improvements.

articleTitle: Action Recognition Using DMM-Gabor Descriptor and Temporal Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, an effective method is proposed for recognizing human actions from sequences of depth images. Specifically, we propose an easy and intuitive method to divide a video into temporal segments of fixed length. Furthermore, the Depth Motion Maps are employed to represent the dynamics and statics of action and uses Gabor feature to gain a compact feature representation. Finally, we use Kernel Extreme Learning Machines for classification. The experimental results on the public MSR Action3D dataset show the proposed method is effective and it achieves good real-time performance.

articleTitle: A Method of TE Process Fault Detection Based on Improved WNBC
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper propose a weighted Naive Bayesian classification (WNBC) fault detection method for industrial processes with simultaneous time-varying, multi-mode and complex data distribution. Estimated the weight of the algorithm by using the test data and selected the attributes according to the relationship between attributes. Based on the Tennessee Eastman(TE) data, this paper validates that the improved algorithm is effectiveness and practicability, which by designing different test scenarios and comparing them with similar methods in the literature.

articleTitle: Multi-feature 3d Model Retrieval Method Based on Shape Context
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The selection of features, the representation of features, and the mode of fusion are keys of 3d model retrieval technology. In the paper, we propose a new 3d model retrieval method which is based on shape context. It combines the fast ORB features and the precise shape context features. ORB features describe the local information. After extracting the CANNY edge information, the shape context features are extracted to describe the global information. Then calculating the final similarity based on shape context features and ORB features. Experimental results demonstrated that our method outperforms several existing methods.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Transfer with Deep Latent Correlation for Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Most traditional methods of image sentiment analysis focus on the design of visual features, and the usefulness of texts associated to the images have not been sufficiently investigated. Heterogeneous transfer learning has recently gained much attention as a new machine learning paradigm in which knowledge can be transferred from source domain feature space to target domain feature space. This paper proposes a novel approach that exploits deep latent correlation between visual and textual modalities. In our proposed method, we build a latent embedding space for symmetric heterogeneous feature transfer. The latent space is able to generate domain-specific and maximally correlative cross-domain features which are regarded as the semantic-intensive visual feature representation and used to train sentiment polarity classifiers. The results of experiments conducted on real-world data sets show that the proposed approach can achieve better sentiment classification accuracy by using multi-layer neural network to capture deeper internal relations.

articleTitle: Topic-Adaptive Sentiment Analysis on Tweets via Learning from Multi-sources Data
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Twitter sentiment analysis model trained from data of one topic may per-forms worse on another topic. While tweets have diverse topics, and the topic of target data of sentiment analysis task is change with the application requirement, which makes it hard to get a good performance. We also notice that one model cannot performs well on every topic, and tweets have no sentiment label to train the model. On the other hand, there are plenty of available text data with sentiment label and topic information such as online movie and product reviews. So we propose a method based on transfer learning, which use topic information and term distribution as a bridge between target tweets and texts from other sources. It could quickly find appropriate in-stances from other sources, and then use them to train a model adapting to target tweets of specific topic for getting better performance. The experiment result shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Tracking the Mobile Jammer Continuously in Time by Using Moving Vector
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In wireless sensor network, due to the shared wireless medium, wireless jamming attacks are easy to be launched by continuously injecting false messages. Such jamming attacks can eliminate the network capacity to execute its expected function. The methods of detecting and localizing the jammer are widely used to deal with such attacks. However, when the jammer is mobile, a jammer tracking method which can localize the jammer with little effort is significant for performing some anti-jamming techniques. In this paper, we propose a moving vector based jammer tracking method. In our proposed method, once the mobile jammer is active, the initial position of jammer can be obtained by any jammer localization algorithm. Then, a approximate moving vector of jammer is calculated at each following time. And the position of jammer at current time can be estimated as the sum of the position at last time and the moving vector. In order to improve the accuracy of tracking results, two improved schemes are also proposed in this paper. We simulate our methods in MATLAB. The experimental results suggest that our methods are effective and they are sensitive to the number and distribution of sensor nodes. Also, the tracking results generated by our methods are more accurate than some existing solutions and our methods are lightweight to produce fewer additional overhead.

articleTitle: Relation Extraction and Discovery from Free Texts via Bootstrapping
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Considering the problem of extracting binary relations from free texts for different domains, we use a universal method with no human supervision. Previous methods based on machine learning tended to extracting relations for a specific domain. When applying to different domains, these methods needed to be retrained based on new features and large amounts of manually labeled data. In this paper, we propose a bootstrapping method of relation extraction which can be adapted to different domains without training and utilizing of domain specific features. Firstly, a set of seeds is generated and the contexts of sentences which contain seeds are extracted as 5-tuples. Secondly, 5-tuples are clustered based on a small set of domain independent features. Thirdly, the 5-tuple whose feature vector has the highest similarity with the central vector of each cluster is chosen as a candidate pattern. Finally, all candidate patterns are evaluated and only the reliable patterns are selected for extracting new relations which shall be added to the set of seeds in next iteration. The experimental results show that our approach outperforms several other methods.

articleTitle: Application Research of Night Intelligent Surveillance System in Residential Quarters
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, Artificial Intelligence research has become a hot topic. However, Intelligent Surveillance based on vision is an important component part of Artificial Intelligence. The paper first extracts the parameters of exterior wall scene used Radon Transform and Polynomial Fitting; the Self-Adaptive Background Subtraction algorithm was developed to detect moving objects; the features of Orthonormal Gaussion-Hermite Moments were used for classification recognition of moving objects. Finally, an early warning system was established. The experiments show that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Traffic Obstacles Comprehensive Identification Using Shape Descriptors in Video
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Traffic obstacle identification has been widely studied as part of the broader obstacle detection area for Autonomous Vehicles (AV). Existing in-vehicle perceptual systems are concentrated on obstacle detection for pedestrian or vehicle, and limited work has been conducted on obstacle comprehensive identification. In general, the feature selection is particularly critical in the process of obstacle identification. As a set of features to describe a given shape or contour, shape descriptor have attracted much attention in recent years and play an important roles in target recognition. This paper proposed a shape descriptor based obstacle comprehensive identification method where the traffic obstacles be classified into four classes: vehicle, lateral moving pedestrian, longitudinal moving pedestrian, and unknown (such as trees, road lamp etc.). Here first a variety of shape descriptors be extracted from the contour curve, such as Hu moment, Zernike moments, Krawtchouk moments, Shape Context, and Axis of Least Inertia. Then, these shape descriptors be used to identification obstacles respectively. Finally, the identification results are contrastive analyzed. Though a single shape descriptor does not achieve ideal identification results for traffic obstacle, but this will provide a new idea for obstacle comprehensive identification using shape descriptor in video for AV.

Author Keywords: Obstacle Comprehensive Identification; Shape descriptor; Hu; Zernike; Krawtchouk; Shape Context; ALI

articleTitle: Hierarchical Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images by Unsupervised Deep Learning Features
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the scale diversity of geographical objects, hierarchical remote sensing image segmentation plays an important role in object-oriented image analysis. In this paper, a hierarchical remote sensing images segmentation method with unsupervised deep learning features is proposed. The unsupervised deep learning features of an image are extracted with a sparse convolutional auto-encoder. Both deep features and the clustering information of deep features are utilized in hierarchical image segmentation which is a bottom-up region merging process. The iterative region merging process starts from an initial partition of an image under a merging criterion. Finally, a tree-like image segmentations hierarchy which contains ground objects of different scales is obtained. The proposed method integrates the advantages of unsupervised deep learning features with region merging-based hierarchical image segmentation. The experiment results have shown the proposed method is superior to the methods using only spectral or spatial features.

articleTitle: T-S Fuzzy Model of a Nonlinear Networked System with Switching Topology and Its Stability and Consensus Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, a T-S fuzzy model of a nonlinear networked system with switching topology (NNSwST) is built, and the stability and consensus problems of the continuous-time NNSwST are investigated based on the proposed T-S fuzzy model. In our proposed T-S fuzzy model, a decentralized fuzzy controller is designed by using parallel distributed compensation algorithm and Lyapunov method. As a consequence, the test of the stability of a NNSwST can be separated into the test of the stability of several nonlinear networked systems by discussing the characteristics of interconnection matrix and the the eigenvalue of Laplacian matrix of the network. Furthermore, a criterion for the consensus of a leader-follower NNSwST based on our T-S fuzzy model is given, it can be reduced to linear matrix inequality (LMI) problems which are numerically feasible. Finally, the performance of the proposed methods is demonstrated by two numerical examples.

articleTitle: Improvement Research on the Project Loan Evaluation of Commercial Bank Based on the Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Project loan evaluation plays an important part in the risk-prevention and quality of assets of commercial bank. The article based on the theory of project evaluation, analyzing the problems in the project loan evaluation of commercial bank, classifying and refining the key risk factors which affecting the project loan repayment ability, and restructuring a risk oriented project loan evaluation indicator system, besides, building the remark set and degree of membership of evaluation indicators, setting up the project loan evaluation criteria, and making a quantitative evaluation and grading for the loan project on the basis of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, at last, doing a empirical research on the actual project, to provide a basis for scientific decision-making and reasonable delivery of project loan of commercial bank.

articleTitle: Effect of VR Interactive Design System on Visual Feedback and Operational Experience
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The commonly used input tools for long-time design work belong to an indirect input with spatial separation between display and operation. This separation requires complex spatial proofreading in order to ensure the accuracy of the operation. The development of VR technology provides a new possibility for the operation and visual feedback. This paper developed an interactive design system based on a VR device and a graphics tablet, and realized the real-time visual feedback in the VR screen. Through inviting designers to participate in the experiment, we explored the effect of various display sizes, operational angles, and paintbrushes in the VR space on the accuracy of operations based on three drawing tasks. The results provided theoretical reference for the application of VR device to professional design software.

articleTitle: An Improved Discrete Grey Model and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The shortcomings of traditional GM(1,1) model and DGM(1,1) model are analyzed when they are applied to forecast a sequence of number. It is proved that the growth rate of simulated data of GM (1,1) and DGM (1,1) model is fixed. It is pointed out that the simulation and prediction results of GM (1,1) and DGM (1,1) models are not ideal for non-exponential growth of data sequences. In order to improve the prediction ability of multi trend data, a nonlinear time varying parameter discrete grey prediction model is constructed by introducing nonlinear time term. PSO algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the model. The examples analysis shows that the nonlinear time varying parameters discrete grey forecasting model proposed in this paper has good simulation accuracy for each type of trend data, and can solve the simulation problem of nonlinear sequence well.

articleTitle: Working Stress Analysis of Rail Transit Driver Based on ECR Model
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The ECR (Extended Contributive Rule) model is used to evaluate the influencing factors of the stress in the driver's driving operation. Then the ISM (Interpretative structural model) model is applied to classify the importance of each factor into a structured model. The results of the survey show that drivers of different groups have different evaluation of the importance of the working stress. Taking into account the objections, there will be some changes in the importance of the drivers in the same group. The conclusion is that the most important factors are workload, skill level and external environment. Finally, according to the analysis results, combined with the driver feedback, the corresponding measures to alleviate the driver's working stress are put forward, which can provide reference for improving the safety level and key personnel management of rail traffic operation.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Representation Learning for Pulmonary Nodule Classification
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Pulmonary nodule classification has aroused much interest for a long time, which can be an effective method for early diagnosis of lung cancer. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems are helpful to realize totally automatic classification for pulmonary nodule, based on computed tomography (CT) scans. It is important to emphasize that even we are easy to access sufficient CT scans, there are always very few annotations related to pulmonary nodules and the annotation process is a huge burden for radiologists. We propose a novel unsupervised representation learning method integrated with convolutional architecture to face the challenge and obtain promising results on the the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) dataset.

articleTitle: Two Methods of Determining Target Orientation by Robot Visual Principle
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: By analyzing the imaging principle of the fish-eye lens in the robot vision, two methods of determination of the target orientation based on the fish-eye lens are summarized. One method uses the distortion correction to determine the target orientation, and the other uses the relationship between the target in the actual orientation and its correspondence in the imaging coordinates to determine the target orientation, both methods all use image processing technology, fast and efficiently determine the orientation of the target in the fish eye image. In this paper, the theoretical basis and experimental process of the two methods are introduced respectively. By comparing the data after the experiment, the more accurate method is analyzed and applied to the target azimuth determination of the fish-eye lens.

articleTitle: Attribute Based Computer Wargaming Rule Model
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Computer wargame is an important way of evaluating operational feasibility before the war and its core is the design, verification and formalization of the rules of wargame. This thesis proposes Attribute Based Computer Wargaming Rule Model (ABCWR) and provides a set of the general formal descriptions and the judgment methods of rules. The model's performance of judging rules was also tested. The testing results show that the time of judging rules is directly proportional to the number of rules in this model and the performance of judging rules meets the requirements of the current scale of business wargame rule base.

articleTitle: Stock Technical Analysis System Based on Real-Time Stream Processing
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Nowadays a large number of applications requires continuous and timely processing of information as it flows from the periphery to the center of the system. Among numerous tools that support these scenarios, the Esper engine is one of the most excellent and practical ones. In this paper, we utilize the Esper engine and a series of financial models to design and implement Stock Technical Analysis System Based on Real-time Stream Processing(STAS). Several general financial models, such as the capital asset pricing model, Candlestick chart, KDJ index and MACD index, are introduced to fulfill the requirements from different users. All these models or indexes are supported by the Esper engine which has a superiority in real-time processing. In this system, users can choose their favorite stocks based on annualized income and visualize these selected stocks in the form of data list, graph and analysis report.

articleTitle: Semantic Reasoning of Question Answering Over Heroes of the Marshes Based on Concept Knowledge Tree
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To make computers obtain a deeper thinking, we propose a question semantic representation model based on concept knowledge tree, which integrates concepts and knowledge to express questions' semantics. Combined the question semantic representation model and related knowledge, we introduce a knowledge-driven semantic reasoning algorithm to recursively obtain new knowledge for deepening the comprehending of questions. We evaluate the performance of our system on a collected dataset, and the top-1 accuracy reaches to 62.1%. Experimental results demonstrate our proposed methods improve the depth of question comprehending.

articleTitle: A Brain Computer Interface Based on Motor Imagery for Maze Game
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Motor imagery electroencephalograph (EEG) signals can be applied in brain computer interface (BCI) systems to make up specific control instructions. In this paper, the common space pattern (CSP) algorithm is used for spatial feature extraction of four different motor imagery (MI) tasks as well as sorting and classifying the features by Multi-Cluster Feature Selection (MCFS) algorithm and Sparse Representation Discrimination Analysis (SRDA) algorithm, the average classification rate can reach 68%. In order to emphasize the feasibility of MI EEG in non-invasive BCI, a maze game is designed and implemented. Subjects can control the process of game successfully in an unshielded environment.

articleTitle: High Speed Maneuvering Target Detection Based on the Modified Keystone Transform
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: A new coherent integration method involves Modified Keystone transform (KT) is proposed for the high speed maneuvering target with a constant jerk. Firstly, the range migration is corrected by the modified KT. Then Doppler frequency migration is compensated with the acceleration and jerk estimated by the modified dechirp process. Finally, the coherent integration is achieved by Fourier Transform. Compared with GRFT method [3],the proposed method has a much lower computational complexity and can avoid the interference of blind speed side lobe (BSSL).

articleTitle: Research of Non-rigid Medical Image Registration Based on Gradient Information
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In many clinical applications, non-rigid transforms are often used to describe the spatial relationships between images. The conventional image registration approaches often consider intensity information, ignoring the spatial information between pixels. To solve the problem, this paper proposes a non-rigid medical image registration algorithm based on gradient information. First, gradient feature of each sample point is obtained for the reference image and floating image. Second, the pixel intensity and the gradient feature are applied into non-rigid medical image registration. Comparison results of the images obtained from lung and brain images showed that the proposed algorithm provides better accuracy than both the conventional rigid registration algorithm and the non-rigid registration algorithm based on single pixel gray values.

articleTitle: Research on Neighborhood Search Strategy of Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm for Satisfiability Problems
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The neighborhood search process plays an important role in artificial bee colony algorithm. Aiming at the problems caused by ignoring the characteristics of a given problem, the neighborhood search strategy for satisfiability problems is studied. To balance the ability of global exploration and local search, the BIR and RIB neighborhood selection strategies are proposed, and four new solution generation strategies are compared and studied. The experimental results show that, compared with the original method, the proposed strategies have improved in varying degrees in performance for stochastic SAT problems.

articleTitle: Research on Cross-Age Face Verification Based on Artificial Neural Network Under Examination Environment
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Nowadays, the fairness of the examination has attracted wide attention, so it's meaningful to design a system to ensure the fairness of examination.Most of current methods focus on detecting abnormal behavior in exams, but our idea is to detect surrogate exam-taker(ghost writer) by comparing the live face photo taken by the camera outside of the examination room with the photo of identification card--one can enter the examination room only if both are identical.In this paper, we have two contributions.Firstly, we design an end-to-end learning framework by designing a multi-task deep neural network for cross-age face verification under examination environment, the proposed CNN network can be directly applied in feature extraction of the face photos and ID-Cards photos.Secondly, we adopt our designed model into the data set from The Authority of Anhui Education, the data set contains 380,000 photos from 190,000 persons, our model achieves superior performance in comparison to current methods, we reach the accuracy at 99.3%.

articleTitle: Research on Author Identification Based on Deep Syntactic Features
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Most approaches to author identification focus mainly on lexical features and ignore syntactic features. This paper argues that, compared with the lexical features, syntactic features can represent plenty of grammatical information and are also irrelevant to the topic. So syntactic features should be widely applied in author identification. In this paper, the syntactic features, especially the syntax tree, are deeply analyzed, and some new features are presented. The experiment proves the validity and great potential of the syntax in author identification.

articleTitle: Ensemble Tracking Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning, many tracking methods based on the convolutional neural network (CNN) have been proposed. They utilize the hierarchical convolutional features extracted from a CNN to show the state-of-the-art results. However, most of these trackers are trained using the convolutional features from only one layer. To address this issue, we propose a novel ensemble tracker based on CNN. Firstly, we construct six trackers, and we combine these trackers to a stronger tracker for predicting the position of the target. For improving the robustness, we extract multiple scales and employ the scale correlation filter to estimate the suitable scale of the target. Experimental results over 51 benchmark sequences demonstrate the proposed approach performs favorably against the state-of-the-art tracking algorithms.

articleTitle: A Novel Digital Broadcasting System Based on Polar Codes in Shortwave
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, on the basis of study on existing DRM system, we make a comparison between rate compatible punctured convolutional codes in DRM system and LDPC code in standard 802.16, then we propose a novel digital broadband broadcasting system based on polar codes in shortwave. Polar codes are used in the novel system to replace multilevel coding scheme in the original DRM system. Simulation shows that polar codes outperform significantly in error correction compared with the other channel coding schemes, and polar codes are capable to effectively enhance the performance of DRM system. In addition, the novel system has a simple process in transmitting terminal and a low complexity, which make it an effective scheme in the next generation of broadband system in shortwave.

articleTitle: Research on Exception Data Cleaning Method Based on Clustering in Hadoop Platform
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the context of the explosive growth of data, the problem of data quality has become increasingly prominent, and it has become the main factor of data analysis and application. In order to get high-quality data, you need to clean the data. In this paper, the cleaning of the anomaly data is carried out. When the K-means clustering method is used for cleaning, the choice of the initial point is too dependent on the clustering result. At the same time, Large data sets of cleaning is easier to take much time becouse of the increasing numbers of operations. For solve these problems, this paper presents a method of anomaly data cleaning based on clustering under Hadoop platform. Firstly, this method improves the K-means algorithm by using the Canopy algorithm and the "minimum maximum principle" and the weighted Euclidean distance. Then it uses the MapReduce programming model to realize the parallelization of the method.
