articleTitle: Route Planning of Mustered Helicopters for Underwater Searching Mission
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper discusses the route planning problem of the helicopters mustered to search the underwater target in the appointed area. The dipping sonar is considered to be used based on the analysis of different searching machines. Then the computation of search time, the coordinates of the detection dots, and the arrangement of the detection dots to helicopters are proposed to solve the route planning problem. Finally, the solution and an example of the proposed algorithm are given.

articleTitle: Job Rejection Strategies in Genetic Algorithm for Permutation Flowshop Scheduling Problem with Rejection
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The permutation flowshop scheduling problem with rejection is studied, with the objective of the minimization of the sum of total rejection cost of all rejected jobs and total tardiness of all accepted jobs. This problem is a joint decision with job rejection and production scheduling, and this paper presented three job rejection strategies under the framework of genetic algorithm. The first one is a serial strategy to reject jobs after scheduling decision. The second one is a parallel strategy to make the two decisions simultaneously. Improved parallel strategy is then presented by employing the serial strategy to optimize the solution obtained by the parallel strategy. Computational experiments are carried out based on a large number of randomly generated instances. The results illustrate that the serial strategy has the best effectiveness but the worst efficiency, and the improved parallel strategy has the close solution quality as the serial strategy but with much shorter computational time.

articleTitle: The Research of Entertainers Collaboration Relation Based on Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To research entertainers' complex collaboration relation network, this article presents a mining technique based on association rule. Using the data which contains cooperation relationship between actors and directors from 200 Chinese movies, association analysising the data sets by Apriori algorithm, and filtering association rules combining with interest factors such as Lift Degree, the article constructs entertainers collaboration relation network. At the end, the article certifies algorithm efficiency and practical application value based on the theory evaluation and value evaluation.

articleTitle: New Estimation Methods for the Navigation Error of the UUVs
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we considered the problem to improve the performance of the UUV when the navigation error exists in the application of target acquisition. The mother ship guides the UUV to acquire the target based on the location information sent back by the UUV. Since the navigation error exists, the discovery probability of the target has been highly decreased. Based on the modeling of the navigation error of the UUV, a least squire (LS) estimation method and a Maximum Likelihood (ML) estimation method are proposed to compensate the navigation error, in which the azimuth of the UUV achieved by the sensors on the mother ship has been used. Simulation results show that the proposed two methods can highly improve the acquisition performance, and the ML estimation method performs even better than the LS estimation method.

articleTitle: Precision Evaluation of the Reconstruction Model Based on Unigraphics
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Precision evaluation of the reconstruction model is a focus in reverse engineering. By precision evaluation, quality of the reconstruction model can be evaluated. In this paper, a series of CT slice images were obtained by industrial Computed Tomography (CT) equipment. Then contour points of CT images were extracted by two dimensional Otsu adaptive threshold algorithm and eight neighborhood method. Finally point cloud model was reconstructed by B-spline surface. In the process of precision evaluation, the line profile error and the surface profile error were used as main evaluation parameters. Experiments show that the method can evaluate the precision of the reconstruction model effectively. This can evaluate the whole precision and the local precision effectively.

articleTitle: The Development of the Simple Transfer Instrument for Reducing the Burden of Caregivers: Effects of the Setting of the Knee Brace
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: At present, in accordance with the increase of the elderly population, nursing personnel's burden is ever increasing, among these those whose responsibility is caring for the bed and wheelchair ridden elderly who are unable to move on their own have an even heavier burden, the risk of lower back injury is extremely high. Therefore, the government has called for those in the nursing field to introduce equipment which aids the nurses in carry out their responsibilities. In recent years, the market has emerged with a variety of related products, and although they can reduce the burden of the nursing staff, due to its complexity, lack of comfort as well as other issues, they have not been popularized. The original laboratory prototype had a very basic design, is easy to use and has been put through a variety of tests using different patients at different times, moreover the adjustable knee support used to reduce stress on the chest and axilla better is the main energy saving element to this piece of equipment which accounts for its superior comfort.

articleTitle: Finding Interesting Cleaning Rules from Dirty Data
publicationTitle: 2017 10th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Data cleaning is an important problem and data quality rules are the most promising way to address it. Previous researches have focused on constraints, such as functional dependencies (FDs), conditional functional dependencies (CFDs), fixing rules, and editing rules. These rules can be provided by experts, or discovered by mining algorithms and then experts verify. But in the condition of dirty dataset, it is highly unlikely that useful FDs could be discovered. If there are no useful cleaning rules, the user can not capture and correct errors in data. In this paper, we develop a system that is able to find interesting rules from dirty data. There is no hope to mine significant functional dependencies directly by the TANE algorithm because of the existence of errors in data. Thus, we discover approximate functional dependencies as candidate cleaning rules with the improved TANE algorithm. The number of candidate rules is very large, making it expensive for the user verification. Since not all candidate rules make sense in practice, we design two kinds of ranking methods: the support-based ranking and the comprehensive score ordering. Our ranking methods usually put the most useful rules ahead. Experimental results show that our sorting methods can effectively help the user find useful cleaning rules.
